slides.text: play soccer and lift? don't treat them as separate
save this. you'll need it at the gym
strength training helps your speed, endurance, stability, and tackle strength. it's not just building muscle, it's building a body that moves better on the field.
but the problem starts when you train with no plan. heavy legs before a match or a hard soccer session? you're walking onto the field gassed.

get a lifting plan that adjusts around your sport
try the app
keep heavy leg days away from match days. days close to games should be lighter. focused on movement and stability.
basics like squats and deadlifts help a ton, just don't overdo the volume. pick the right weight, keep your form clean.
the goal is for lifting to make you stronger for the game, not slower or gassed.
